description: This file implements the CachedGrainLocator class, which manages lookup, registration, and unregistration of grain addresses within the Orleans runtime. It uses caching for efficiency and monitors cluster membership changes to keep the cache consistent.

classes.name: CachedGrainLocator
classes.description: Implements the IGrainLocator interface with caching and cluster membership awareness, for locating grain addresses efficiently.

classes.name: CachedGrainLocator.ITestAccessor
classes.description: Interface for testing access, exposing the LastMembershipVersion property.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up a grain address by its GrainId, checking the cache first, then the directory, and handling dead silos.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address, updating the directory and cache, handling dead silo entries.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a grain address from the cache and directory, ensuring consistency.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes to the silo lifecycle to manage cluster change listening.

methods.name: ListenToClusterChange
methods.description: Monitors cluster membership updates to detect terminated silos and unregister their addresses.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates the cache with a grainId and silo address.

methods.name: InvalidateCache (by GrainId and by GrainAddress)
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries by grain identifier or address.

methods.name: TryLookupInCache
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a grain address from the cache, validating liveness.
